segments.ja365:2.1: Alikaṃ vata maṃ samma, abhūtena pasaṃsasi;
segments.ja365:2.3: Ko te suto vā diṭṭho vā, sumukho nāma makkaṭo.
segments.ja365:3.1: Ajjāpi me taṃ manasi [te maṃ sarasi (ka.)], yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ ahituṇḍika;
segments.ja365:3.3: Dhaññāpaṇaṃ pavisitvā, matto [mutto (ka.)] chātaṃ hanāsi maṃ.
segments.ja365:4.1: Tāhaṃ saraṃ dukkhaseyyaṃ, api rajjampi kāraye;
segments.ja365:4.3: Nevāhaṃ yācito dajjaṃ, tathā hi bhayatajjito.
segments.ja365:5.1: Yañca jaññā kule jātaṃ, gabbhe tittaṃ amacchariṃ;
